definitions.name: E0A.RUNS
definitions.body: 'V' BIND [ 0 ] V -1 DROP V 1 DROP 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 'P' BIND 0 1 P 1 TAKE P -1 TAKE EQ SELECT ] MAP CONCAT 0 [ ADD ] SCAN V GROUP VALUES
definitions.note: Vector -> Vector of its maximal runs of equal adjacent elements (each run a Vector), in order; works for numbers, Strings, Booleans, NIL

definitions.name: E0A.SUM
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> their sum (0 for empty)

definitions.name: E0A.VMAX
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD

definitions.name: E0A.ARGMAX
definitions.note: non-empty Vector of numbers -> index of the first occurrence of its largest value

definitions.name: E0A.MOD
definitions.body: 'B' BIND 'A' BIND A A B DIV FLOOR B MUL SUB
definitions.note: a b -> a mod b (floored remainder); a may be a Vector

definitions.name: E0A.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE [ 'D' BIND N D E0A.MOD 0 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: positive integer -> Vector of its positive divisors, ascending

definitions.name: E0A.PRESENT
definitions.note: Vector -> the elements that are not NIL, in order

definitions.name: E0A.REDUCE
definitions.body: 'S' BIND 0 S CHARS LENGTH RANGE S [ 'I' BIND '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> what remains after repeatedly deleting adjacent '()' and '[]' pairs

definitions.name: E0A.BALANCED
definitions.note: bracket String -> TRUE when every ( ) [ ] is properly matched and nested

definitions.name: E0A.WORDS
definitions.note: String -> Vector of its space-separated words, empty pieces dropped

definitions.name: E0A.UNWORDS
definitions.note: Vector of words -> one String joined by single spaces

definitions.name: E0A.ORDERS
definitions.note: JSON String -> Vector of the order Records under its 'orders' key

definitions.name: E0A.LINE
definitions.body: 'R' BIND R 'qty' GET R 'price' GET MUL 'X' BIND 0 X X NIL? SELECT
definitions.note: order Record -> qty times price, or 0 when it has no price

definitions.name: E0A.REVENUE
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> total qty*price over priced orders

definitions.name: E0A.QTYBYSKU
definitions.body: E0A.ORDERS 'O' BIND O [ 'sku' GET ] MAP O [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ E0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> Record sku -> summed qty, skus in first-appearance order
